corrections: Used the clarified TP17 demonstration configuration values: Tank 1 high setpoint 0.80 m, wait after Tank 1 low 10 s, and inter-cycle wait after Tank 2 low 8 s, preserving older conflicting values only in this note rather than the executable parameters.

Used the simplified legacy demonstration level-balance equations and nominal flows from 09_07_legacy_tank_demo.txt as an explicit modeling assumption because no authoritative acausal fluid parameters such as pressures, valve Cv, or port geometry were provided.
Represented reported valve variables valve1_open, valve2_open, and valve3_open as numeric percent values 0 or 100, matching the note that valve open variables are numeric with units %.

Used BooleanTable pulse widths of 0.5 s for START, STOP, and SHUT command occurrences as an executable assumption so each scheduled command produces one rising edge; the brief states command times but not pulse durations.

Used controller_state as an Integer code in the executable model because the brief identifies the report variable name and says some fragments use a string, but the provided constraints do not establish a standard string-valued Modelica report representation.
